performance.summary: The mean of the two run medians changes by -2.7 percent versus the published surface package; mean draw calls change by +18.3 percent. The update does not meet the retained median <= 33.4 ms and p95 <= 50 ms target in both measured runs. These four short ABBA runs share authored weather, epoch and a normalized physical sun vector, with the baseline sun convention corrected only in memory. They include presentation, common forcing-verification overhead and uncontrolled desktop load; GPU execution time is unavailable. They do not establish other-hardware performance.
